objective: Prevent Android IGPAT upload memory crashes AND ensure newly uploaded IGPAT/Community videos use Supabase Storage only, matching authoritative IGPAT publishing checks. Keep legacy external media readable without uploading new content there.
productionBaselineEvidence: Prior captured Android heap OOM at ~255/256 MB, full-file bytesSync upload OOM in R20; bounded uploader still present on current main; no current device crash log or production artifact fingerprint checked.
chosenApproach: Pause/release off-focus IGPAT feed players and Reels ad views; unmount creator video preview during active upload; postpone ad warming until video transport is complete. Preserve existing server and transport logic. Also retire new AWS upload routing across shared IGPAT/Community video transport, route every newly selected video to Supabase signed PUT (<6MiB) or bounded TUS (>=6MiB), guard unknown sizes, and keep all historical AWS reads until safe object migration.
preserveBehaviors: IGPAT active and next-video preloading while feed is focused
Reels sponsored ad cadence and existing consent gates
Video upload routing and S3 multipart bounded memory
Advertise only after successful server publishing
No OTA, Play, Web or DB release from this branch
No changes to legacy 17 AWS media records or to existing authorization/ACL; preserve their playback until explicit migration
Supabase Pro configured 1GiB private community-media bucket; no new paid infrastructure, credentials or native dependencies
acceptanceChecks: Focused feed plays active video; background feed mounts no video players or ad views
Creator preview not decoded during active upload; restored after failure
Interstitial warmed only after upload completes, shown only after RPC success
Require Android crash evidence before calling underlying cause proven
IGPAT and Wall videos >45MiB never use AWS: Supabase TUS 6MiB chunks and existing offset recovery
Unknown video size stops before single PUT; IGPAT R10 Supabase object verification matches upload path
releaseStatus: DEV-only, hold OTA until consolidated RC
selectionRationale: Existing native bounded upload already prevents full-file bytesSync, but creator preview plus hidden feed decoders and prewarmed interstitial overlap can exacerbate the previously proven Android heap pressure. Minimal screen-focus lifecycle fix avoids changing native storage/API and monetization. Current production R10 IGPAT RPC checks storage.objects only in community-media; prior >45MiB AWS upload causes deterministic 'Uploaded IGPAT video was not found' after transport success. Supabase Pro community-media bucket is configured for 1GiB and existing 6MiB TUS client handles weak-network uploads. Remove AWS write branch and fail closed on unknown video size.
alternativeApproaches: Raising Android largeHeap rejected as hiding player/ads leaks and increasing process death risk
Disabling IGPAT Reels ads entirely rejected because viewability-gated ad cadence remains required; unmount only when route is unfocused
Rewriting S3 multipart or TUS transport rejected without a new crash trace, because the native bounded upload code is already present
Do not alter the production IGPAT SQL to falsely accept missing Supabase media paths or accept arbitrary external references, as this breaks media ACLs and causes blank videos.
